{
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "waitlist_entries",
        "purpose": "Tracks every shopper's expressed interest in a sold-out item, at variant or product level.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal id" },
          { "name": "shopper_email", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "email address to notify" },
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the product the shopper is waiting on" },
          { "name": "variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "null when the signup is at product level; set when shopper picked a specific variant" },
          { "name": "scope", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["variant", "product"], "purpose": "whether the entry is tracked at variant or product level" },
          { "name": "unsubscribe_token", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "unique token embedded in every email's unsubscribe link; used to identify the shopper across all their entries" },
          { "name": "status", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'", "enum": ["active", "notified", "removed"], "purpose": "active, notified, or removed" },
          { "name": "signed_up_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "deleted_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "set when tombstoned due to product deletion or unsubscribe" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["shopper_email", "product_external_id", "variant_external_id"],
        "indexes": [
          ["product_external_id", "variant_external_id", "status", "signed_up_at"],
          ["unsubscribe_token"],
          ["product_external_id", "deleted_at"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "notification_batches",
        "purpose": "Represents one restock event for an item and tracks how many notifications have been queued and sent from it.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "variant_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "null when the batch is for a product-level waitlist" },
          { "name": "restock_detected_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "available_quantity_at_restock", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "quantity Shopify reported when the restock was detected" },
          { "name": "notify_cap", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "copy of the merchant setting at batch creation so historical batches remain accurate" },
          { "name": "total_queued", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "total_sent", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "status", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'", "enum": ["open", "completed", "cancelled"], "purpose": "open, completed, or cancelled" },
          { "name": "created_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["product_external_id", "variant_external_id", "restock_detected_at"],
        "indexes": [
          ["status", "created_at"],
          ["product_external_id", "variant_external_id", "status"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "notification_sends",
        "purpose": "One row per shopper per batch — the atomic unit the email scheduler dispatches and the attribution anchor for conversions.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "batch_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the restock batch this send belongs to" },
          { "name": "waitlist_entry_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the waitlist entry being notified" },
          { "name": "shopper_email", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "denormalized for fast dispatch without a join" },
          { "name": "queue_position", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "signup-order position within the batch; enforces FIFO and notify-cap cutoff" },
          { "name": "status", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'", "enum": ["queued", "dispatched", "failed", "skipped"], "purpose": "queued, dispatched, failed, or skipped" },
          { "name": "failure_reason", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "queued_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "dispatched_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["batch_id", "waitlist_entry_id"],
        "indexes": [
          ["status", "queue_position"],
          ["shopper_email", "dispatched_at"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "conversions",
        "purpose": "Records when a notified shopper purchases the item within the 7-day attribution window.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "notification_send_id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_sends(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the dispatched send credited with this conversion" },
          { "name": "order_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "the order that closed the attribution loop" },
          { "name": "converted_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["notification_send_id", "order_external_id"],
        "indexes": [
          ["notification_send_id"],
          ["order_external_id"]
        ],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "email_template",
        "purpose": "Stores the merchant-configured email subject and body template with dynamic variable placeholders.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "singleton row — code enforces at most one row" },
          { "name": "subject_template", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "supports {{product_name}} and {{variant_label}} placeholders" },
          { "name": "body_template", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "supports {{product_name}}, {{variant_label}}, {{product_url}}, {{unsubscribe_url}} placeholders" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "app_settings",
        "purpose": "Stores merchant-configured operational parameters: quiet hours window and per-restock notification cap.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id", "sqlType": "UUID", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "singleton row — code enforces at most one row" },
          { "name": "quiet_hours_start", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 22", "purpose": "hour of day (0-23) at which sending is paused" },
          { "name": "quiet_hours_end", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 8", "purpose": "hour of day (0-23) at which sending resumes" },
          { "name": "per_restock_notify_cap", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 100", "purpose": "maximum shoppers to notify per restock batch; remainder waits for the next restock" },
          { "name": "updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "waitlist_snapshots",
        "purpose": "Pre-aggregated per-product waitlist counts refreshed on every signup or removal, enabling instant-load dashboard ranking without full-table scans.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "product_external_id", "sqlType": "BIGINT", "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY", "purpose": "the product this snapshot summarises" },
          { "name": "product_title", "sqlType": "TEXT", "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "denormalized title fetched at first signup and refreshed on products/update; avoids live Shopify lookups on every dashboard render" },
          { "name": "active_entry_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "total_notified_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "total_conversion_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 0", "purpose": null },
          { "name": "last_updated_at", "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()", "purpose": null }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [["active_entry_count"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/delete",
      "orders/paid"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": "*/2 * * * *"
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "widget": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/availability", "purpose": "Return live availability for a product/variant so the widget decides whether to show the sign-up form." },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/signup",        "purpose": "Register a shopper's email on the waitlist for a sold-out item." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/signup",        "purpose": "Check whether a given email is already on the waitlist for an item." },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/unsubscribe",   "purpose": "Remove a shopper from all their waitlist entries using the token from their email footer link." }
    ],
    "admin": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/dashboard",        "purpose": "Return a paginated list of products ranked by active waitlist size." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/waitlist",         "purpose": "Return a paginated list of individual subscribers for a specific product or variant." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/waitlist/export",  "purpose": "Stream a CSV of all subscriber entries for a given product or variant." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/stats",            "purpose": "Return aggregated conversion funnel metrics." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/template",         "purpose": "Return the current email subject and body template for the editor." },
      { "method": "PUT",  "path": "/admin/template",         "purpose": "Save an updated email subject and body template." },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/settings",         "purpose": "Return the current quiet-hours window and per-restock notify cap." },
      { "method": "PUT",  "path": "/admin/settings",         "purpose": "Save updated quiet-hours and notify-cap settings." }
    ]
  }
}
